strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Adds Rust-owned trust approval for cached remote Mode Pack candidates before active replacement.
Approval recompiles cached candidate policy and rejects unsafe permissions or duplicate built-in mode IDs before trust state is written.
Approval persists bounded trusted-candidate state and one idempotent ledger event without raw candidate JSON.
Headless callers can gate later activation on deterministic approved-candidate evidence instead of manual cache inspection.

answers.strategic_capabilities: mode_pack_runtime with support from runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: modepack.approveCandidate approves one cached remote candidate after explicit authorization, content SHA verification, compiled policy fingerprint verification, policy revalidation, and bounded approval persistence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M38.1 fetches and caches untrusted candidates, while M37 replacement and rollback operate on active snapshots and cannot represent trusted cached-candidate eligibility.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Remote candidates remain cached but untrusted, forcing later activation to either trust fetched candidates implicitly or duplicate approval checks inside replacement.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M38.1 fetch/cache, M37.2 rollback, and M37.1 active replacement because it writes candidate trust state without network fetch or active mutation.
answers.no_new_rpc: No. Existing fetch, replace, rollback, and read RPCs cannot mutate candidate trust state.
answers.no_new_summary: No new report wrapper is added; the result is bounded execution evidence for a trust-state mutation.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime can re-read cached candidate bytes, recompile policy, verify expected fingerprints, persist approved eligibility state, and append bounded ledger evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled caller can decide that a specific fetched candidate is eligible for later controlled activation without raw JSON or manual filesystem review.
answers.milestone_progress: Adds the trust layer between M38.1 remote acquisition and the future controlled remote candidate activation phase.

exit_criteria: expected_content_sha256 and expected_compiled_policy_fingerprint are required SHA-256 fingerprints
Unknown cached candidates are rejected before approval state is written
Cached content SHA-256 and cached summary SHA-256 must match the expected content fingerprint
Cached candidate JSON is recompiled and duplicate built-in mode IDs or unsafe permissions are rejected before trust state is written
Compiled policy fingerprint must match both the expected fingerprint and cached summary fingerprint
Successful approval writes bounded approved candidate state with consumed=false and records one ModePackCandidateApproved event
Replaying the same approval returns the same approval event id and does not append duplicate approval evidence
RPC and ledger payloads return bounded summaries only and contain no raw Mode Pack JSON or raw ledger payload
Behavior tests cover approval/replay, authorization denial, unknown candidate denial, and fingerprint mismatch denial

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M38.2 changes runtime/protocol/store/VSIX behavior and phase manifests; review must confirm this is candidate trust-state mutation, not activation or wrapper surface.
